ideas.name: Startup Legal Advisor
ideas.problem: Early-stage startups, especially those with EU founders operating in the US, face significant challenges in navigating complex legal and VC landscapes. This tool provides curated legal resources, template agreements, and connections to experienced legal advisors for startups.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2B, tiered pricing from 49 USD/month for basic resources to 199 USD/month for advisor connections and template packages.

ideas.name: LLM Context Analyzer
ideas.problem: Developers working with Large Language Models (LLMs) need tools to efficiently understand and debug model behavior across different contexts and timeframes. This meta-tool analyzes LLM outputs, flags inconsistencies, and summarizes key developments over specified periods.
ideas.monetization: SaaS B2D, tiered pricing based on API usage and features, starting at 99 USD/month.
